source.title: Forum Digest (October 2023)
source.content:
Here are some notable threads on the WCA Forum during the third quarter of 2023.

[**Registration of the WCA as a sports organization**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/registration-of-the-wca-as-a-sports-organization/37190)
The WCA is currently working towards becoming a recognized sports organization. This thread discusses all doubts and queries the community raised regarding what constitutes a sport and the process of making speedcubing an officially recognized sport.

[**Timebase Prototype Showcase**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/timebase-the-future-of-competitions/41504)
Two cubers from the USA brought a novel implementation that gets rid of the traditional scorecards and signatures. They tested out Timebase at a few competitions they are organizing. This is a great idea and in the process of becoming a reality. It is presently not allowed as the primary source of scoretaking as per the Regulations.

[**Uniform Scramble Sets at Major Championships**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/ensuring-fairness-and-consistency-a-call-for-uniform-scramble-sets-at-major-championships/39282)
The discussion set off after the World Championship 2023 concluded. The proposal was to enforce the same scramble sets for finals and penultimate rounds at large-sized competitions in order to have a fair selection of the winners. 

[**Trial Rounds for Newcomers**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/trial-rounds-for-new-competitors/40072)
Newcomers have a lot of problems handling the Speed Stack timers which leads to extras being given by the Delegates. This proposal discusses if having one trial solve of that puzzle at the solving station should be a mandate for newcomers.

**Cube Talk Summary**
The idea of starting cube talk was to get cubers conversant on the forums on most attractive questions. We have got great answers on four topics recently which are: 

* What is your favourite event? 
* Do you prefer running, judging, scrambling or scoretaking? 
* Who is your favorite WCA Delegate? 
* How do you feel about reserving competition places only for newcomers? 

We hope to continue the series asking more questions to the community.

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback feel free to send an email to [advisory@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:advisory@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thanks for being a part of the Forum!

translation.title: 论坛话题精选（2023 年 10 月）
translation.content:
以下是 WCA 论坛在 2023 年第三季度的一些值得关注的话题。

[**将 WCA 注册为体育组织**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/registration-of-the-wca-as-a-sports-organization/37190)
WCA 目前正努力成为获认可的体育组织。这个帖子讨论了社区就“什么算体育运动”以及“如何让速拧成为正式认可的体育运动”提出的疑问。

[**Timebase 原型展示**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/timebase-the-future-of-competitions/41504)
两位美国魔友提出了一种新方案，可以不再使用传统的成绩单和签名。他们已在自己组织的几场比赛中测试 Timebase。这是一个很好的想法，也正在逐步落地。不过，根据现行规则，它目前还不能作为主要的成绩记录方式。

[**大型锦标赛使用统一打乱**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/ensuring-fairness-and-consistency-a-call-for-uniform-scramble-sets-at-major-championships/39282)
这一讨论始于 2023 年世界锦标赛结束后。提议要求大型比赛的决赛及倒数第二轮使用同一套打乱，以公平地决出优胜者。

[**为首次参赛者安排试拧**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/trial-rounds-for-new-competitors/40072)
首次参赛者往往不熟悉 Speed Stacks 计时器的使用，因而需要由代表安排额外还原。这个提议讨论是否应要求首次参赛者在比赛位上先试拧一次相应项目。

**Cube Talk 话题小结**
推出 Cube Talk，是希望围绕大家最感兴趣的问题，让魔友们在论坛上聊起来。最近以下四个话题收到了不少精彩回答：

* 你最喜欢哪个项目？
* 你更喜欢传魔方、当裁判、打乱还是录入成绩？
* 你最喜欢哪位 WCA 代表？
* 你怎么看为首次参赛者预留比赛名额？

我们希望继续这个系列，向社区提出更多问题。

如有疑问、意见或反馈，欢迎发送邮件至 [advisory@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:advisory@worldcubeassociation.org)。

感谢大家参与论坛！
